desc: Implement input parsing for H, W, X, P, Q and the H×W grid of strengths (values up to 1e12, X up to 1e9).
Implement the greedy max-heap simulation: heap of (-S, i, j) frontier cells, visited boolean grid, current strength initialized to S[P-1][Q-1], seed heap with the 4 neighbors of the start.
In the pop loop, skip stale/visited entries; check absorb condition S*X < cur; if true, add to cur and push unvisited neighbors; else break.
Argue/verify correctness of the greedy choice (strongest-first with early termination) and confirm strict inequality uses multiplication to avoid floating point.
Test edge cases mentally: X=1 (nothing absorbable since S < cur requires S strictly less), single cell grid, and large values near 1e12*1e9.
Write final solution with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read) and print the final strength.
